title: Taiwanese Association – NC Chapter 北卡 台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese Association – NC Chapter (北卡 台灣同鄉會) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA), the national umbrella organization serving Taiwanese American communities across the United States. The NC Chapter serves Taiwanese Americans in North Carolina and is listed under the TAA’s Eastern Southern regional grouping.
